title: Whodunit: The Vanishing Vintner
story: In a quaint town of Berryville, resided a wealthy and kind-hearted wine tycoon, Mr. Aubrey Winston. Late one moonlit night, the police received a frantic call from Mrs. Winston, the victim's wife, stating her husband hadn't returned from his late-night walk. Upon investigation, they discovered Mr. Winston's lifeless body lying in the vineyard. His watch, still ticking, showed 11:15 PM, precisely the time he left home.
forensicClue: A peculiar grape stain on the victim's coat
question: Who killed Mr. Aubrey Winston and why?
options: Option D (The winemaker and a grudge)
